content.text:
**Fast DDS** 是 eProsima 公司开源的 **DDS(Data Distribution Service)** 中间件实现,原名 Fast RTPS,Apache 2.0 许可。

## 核心概念
- **DDS** 是 OMG 定义的**发布/订阅**中间件标准,面向实时分布式系统。
- Fast DDS 实现了 DDSI-RTPS 有线协议,所以能和别的 DDS 实现(如 Cyclone DDS、RTI Connext)互操作。

## 关键特性
| 特性 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 发布/订阅 | 以 Topic 为中心,无中心 broker,点对点直连 |
| 自动发现 | SPDP/SEDP 自动发现参与者与端点 |
| QoS 策略 | 可靠性、持久性、Deadline、Liveliness、History 等 |
| 语言支持 | C++ 为主,提供 Python 绑定 |
| 传输 | UDP / TCP / SHM(共享内存),支持安全(DDS Security) |
| 扩展 | REST/WebSocket 网关、录制回放、监控 |

## 常见用途
- **ROS 2**:Fast DDS 是默认 RMW 之一(常见替代是 Cyclone DDS)
- 自动驾驶、工业物联网、航空航天、机器人等对实时性和可靠性要求高的场景

## 和 ROS 2 的关系
ROS 2 本身不自带通信层,而是通过 RMW 抽象层对接 DDS。用 Fast DDS 时:
```bash
export RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp
```
配置通常放在 `FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE` 指向的 XML 里。

**Fast DDS 就是一个让程序之间互相传消息的中间件。**

- 谁想收,就订阅这个话题,自动收到
- **不用写服务器**,也没有中心节点,谁在线自己会发现对方

#!/bin/bash
set -e

current_pwd="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
cmake_dir="${current_pwd}/cmake"
platform=$1
Lib_type=shared
top_output_dir="${current_pwd}/output/galbot_sdk"
Release_Debug_mode=$2

toolchain_cpp="g++"

function get_string() {
    file_path=$1
    key_word=$2
    key_IFS=$3

    [[ ! -f ${file_path} ]] && echo "config: ${file_path} not exist" && exit 1
    toochain=$(grep "$key_word" $file_path | awk -F "${key_IFS}" '{print $2}' | sed s/\)//g)
    ENV=$(echo ${toochain} | grep "ENV")
    [[ -z "${ENV}" ]] && echo ${toochain} && return

    ## get ENV name
    element=$(echo "${ENV}" | cut -d '{' -f2 | cut -d '}' -f1)
    suffix=$(echo "${ENV}" | cut -d '{' -f2 | cut -d '}' -f2)

    ## get ENV value
    env_value=$(env | grep $element | cut -d '=' -f2)
    toochain=${env_value}${suffix}
    echo ${toochain}
}

function show_usage() {
    echo -e "usage:\n" \
        "\e[32m\t./build.sh <platform> <mode>\e[0m\nhelps:\n" \
        "\tplatform\t: linux-x86_64-gcc940 linux-aarch64-gcc940 linux-aarch64-gcc1330\n" \
        "\tmode\t\t: debug release, default is release\n"
}

function setup_env() {
    if [ ! -n "$platform" ]; then
        show_usage
        exit 1
    fi

    cmake_mmapi_param=""
    if [ "$platform" == "linux-x86_64-gcc940" ]; then
        plat_cmake=$cmake_dir/linux-x86_64-gcc940.cmake
        # arch_output_dir="${current_pwd}/output/linux-x86_64-gcc940/bin"
    elif [ "$platform" == "linux-aarch64-gcc940" ]; then
        plat_cmake=$cmake_dir/linux-aarch64-gcc940.cmake
        # arch_output_dir="${current_pwd}/output/linux-aarch64-gcc940/bin"
        default_mmapi_root="${current_pwd}/deps/jetson-mmapi-orin"
    elif [ "$platform" == "linux-aarch64-gcc1330" ]; then
        plat_cmake=$cmake_dir/linux-aarch64-gcc1330.cmake
        # arch_output_dir="${current_pwd}/output/linux-aarch64-gcc1330/bin"
        default_mmapi_root="${current_pwd}/deps/jetson-mmapi-thor"
    else
        echo "platform $platform not recognized"
        show_usage
        exit 1
    fi

    if [ -n "${default_mmapi_root:-}" ]; then
        jetson_mmapi_root="${JETSON_MMAPI_ROOT:-${default_mmapi_root}}"
        if [ "$platform" == "linux-aarch64-gcc1330" ]; then
            mmapi_vendor_lib_dir="${jetson_mmapi_root}/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/nvidia"
        else
            mmapi_vendor_lib_dir="${jetson_mmapi_root}/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/tegra"
        fi
        if [ ! -f "${jetson_mmapi_root}/usr/src/jetson_multimedia_api/include/NvBufSurface.h" ] || \

            echo "Jetson MMAPI staging root is incomplete for ${platform}: ${jetson_mmapi_root}" >&2
            echo "Required: NvBufSurface.h, libnvbufsurface.so, libEGL.so.1" >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        cmake_mmapi_param="-DJETSON_MMAPI_ROOT=${jetson_mmapi_root}"

    toolchain_cpp=$(echo ${toolchain_c%cc*}++)

    mkdir -p $top_output_dir
    # mkdir -p $arch_output_dir

}

function extract_gbs_libs() {
    # 从CMakeLists.txt中读取GBS_VERSION
    local gbs_version=""
    local cmake_file="${current_pwd}/CMakeLists.txt"
    
    if [ -f "${cmake_file}" ]; then
        gbs_version=$(grep -E '^\s*set\s*\(\s*GBS_VERSION\s+"[^"]*"' "${cmake_file}" | \
            sed -nE 's/^\s*set\s*\(\s*GBS_VERSION\s+"([^"]*)".*$/\1/p' | head -n1)
    fi
    
    if [ -z "${gbs_version}" ]; then
        echo "error: cannot get GBS_VERSION from CMakeLists.txt"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "提取GBS三方库"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "平台: ${platform}"
    echo "GBS版本: ${gbs_version}"
    echo "=========================================="
    
    local extract_script="${current_pwd}/submodules/galbot_sdk_common/scripts/extract_gbs_libs.sh"
    
    if [ ! -f "${extract_script}" ]; then
        echo "错误: 找不到提取脚本: ${extract_script}"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # 调用提取脚本
    "${extract_script}" "${platform}" "${gbs_version}"
    
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "错误: GBS库提取失败"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "GBS三方库提取完成"
    echo ""
}

function build_module() {
    local mode=$1
    local shared=$2
    local link_version=$3

    if [[ ${mode} != "release" ]] && [[ ${mode} != "debug" ]]; then
        mode="release"
    fi
    echo "compiler mode: ${mode}"

    if [[ ${shared} != "shared" ]] && [[ ${shared} != "static" ]]; then
        shared="shared"
    fi

    echo "compiler shared: ${shared}"
    if [[ ${link_version} != "release" ]] && [[ ${link_version} != "back" ]]; then
        link_version="release"
    fi
    echo "link version: ${link_version}"

    # 提取GBS三方库
    extract_gbs_libs
    
    local CMAKE_PARAM="-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-fPIC -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-fPIC -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${mode}" ### -DCMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE=ON" ### -DCMAKE_LIB_TYPE=${shared} -DLINK_VERSION=${link_version} 
    echo "build dds param=${CMAKE_PARAM}"

    # 按平台使用独立 build 目录，便于多架构并行/增量编译且不互相污染
    local build_dir=".build-${platform}"
    mkdir -p "${build_dir}"

    pushd "${build_dir}"

    cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${top_output_dir}/${platform}/ -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${plat_cmake} \
        ${cmake_mmapi_param} ${CMAKE_PARAM}

    make install -j 8

    popd

}

function main() {
    setup_env
    build_module ${Release_Debug_mode} ${Lib_type}
}

main $@

read_sdk_version() {
    local version_file="${PROJECT_ROOT}/VERSION"
    if [[ ! -f "${version_file}" ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] VERSION 文件不存在: ${version_file}" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    local version
    version="$(sed -n '1{s/[[:space:]]//g;p;q;}' "${version_file}")"
    if [[ -z "${version}" ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] VERSION 文件为空: ${version_file}" >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "${version}"
}

_current_dir = Path(__file__).parent
_so_path = _current_dir / _so_filename

# 库文件不存在时的错误处理
if not _so_path.exists():
    raise ImportError(

        f"  Expected file : {_so_filename}\n"
        f"  Python        : {_python_version}\n"
        f"  Architecture  : {_arch}\n"

This package provides G1-specific wrappers for GalbotNavigation, GalbotMotion,
GalbotPerception, and GalbotRobot that automatically initialize with MachineType.G1.

Usage:
    from galbot_sdk.g1 import GalbotNavigation, GalbotMotion, GalbotPerception, GalbotRobot

    nav = GalbotNavigation()
    nav.init()

    motion = GalbotMotion()
    motion.init()

    robot = GalbotRobot()
    robot.init()
    robot.set_joint_positions(...)

    # Clean shutdown (REQUIRED on program exit)
    robot.request_shutdown()
    robot.wait_for_shutdown()
    robot.destroy()
"""

    MachineType,
    GalbotNavigation as _BaseGalbotNavigation,
    GalbotMotion as _BaseGalbotMotion,
    GalbotPerception as _BaseGalbotPerception,
    GalbotRobot as _BaseGalbotRobot,
)

    G1-specific GalbotNavigation wrapper.
    Automatically initialized with MachineType.G1 - no need to pass it explicitly.

    _py_instance = None

    def __new__(cls):
        if cls._py_instance is None:

    def __init__(self):
        if GalbotNavigation._instance is None:
            GalbotNavigation._instance = _BaseGalbotNavigation.get_instance(MachineType.G1)

class GalbotRobot:

    G1-specific GalbotRobot wrapper.

project(galbot_sdk_pybind)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED True)

    set(GALBOT_PYBIND_JETSON_VENDOR_RPATH
        "/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/tegra"
        "/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/tegra-egl")
endif()

# pybind 模块名基础（仅用于区分不同 Python 版本的 target 名）
set(PY_MODULE_NAME "sdk")

set(SUBMODULE_PATH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../submodules/)
message(STATUS "SUBMODULE_PATH: ${SUBMODULE_PATH}")
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 加载 common.cmake（SDK 路径、工具链等）
# -------------------------------------------------------------
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common.cmake)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 检测宿主机架构
# -------------------------------------------------------------
execute_process(
    COMMAND uname -m
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE HOST_ARCH
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)
message(STATUS "Host architecture: ${HOST_ARCH}")
message(STATUS "Toolchain: ${TARGET_PLAT_GCC}")

if(TARGET_PLAT_GCC STREQUAL "linux-x86_64-gcc940")
    set(PYBIND_THIRDPARTY_ROOT ${SUBMODULE_PATH}/galbot_sdk_common/submodules/ThirdParty/gcc940-x86_64-ubuntu2004-gnu)
elseif(TARGET_PLAT_GCC STREQUAL "linux-aarch64-gcc940")
    set(PYBIND_THIRDPARTY_ROOT ${SUBMODULE_PATH}/galbot_sdk_common/submodules/ThirdParty/gcc940-aarch64-ubuntu2004-gnu)
elseif(TARGET_PLAT_GCC STREQUAL "linux-aarch64-gcc1330")
    set(PYBIND_THIRDPARTY_ROOT ${SUBMODULE_PATH}/galbot_sdk_common/submodules/ThirdParty/gcc13.3-aarch64-ubuntu2404-gnu)
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsupported TARGET_PLAT_GCC for pybind ThirdParty: ${TARGET_PLAT_GCC}")
endif()
set(PYBIND_THIRDPARTY_LIB_DIR ${PYBIND_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/lib)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 设置支持的 Python 版本列表
# -------------------------------------------------------------
set(PYTHON_VERSIONS "python3.8" "python3.9" "python3.10" "python3.11" "python3.12" "python3.13" "python3.14")

if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/pybind11/include")

    include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/pybind11/include)

    if(NOT PYBIND11_INCLUDE_DIR)

    include_directories(${PYBIND11_INCLUDE_DIR})

    ${SUBMODULE_PATH}/galbot_robot/pybind/src/galbot_robot_pybind.cpp
    ${SUBMODULE_PATH}/galbot_robot/pybind/src/robot_type_pybind.cpp
    ${SUBMODULE_PATH}/galbot_motion/pybind/src/motion_type_pybind.cpp
    ${SUBMODULE_PATH}/galbot_motion/pybind/src/galbot_motion_pybind.cpp
    ${SUBMODULE_PATH}/galbot_motion/pybind/src/motion_plan_config_pybind.cpp
    ${SUBMODULE_PATH}/galbot_navigation/pybind/src/galbot_navigation_pybind.cpp
    ${SUBMODULE_PATH}/galbot_perception/pybind/src/perception_interface_pybind.cpp
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 遍历 Python 版本生成独立模块
# -------------------------------------------------------------
foreach(PY_VER ${PYTHON_VERSIONS})

    # Python include
    set(PYTHON_INCLUDE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/python/include/${PY_VER})
    if(NOT EXISTS "${PYTHON_INCLUDE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing Python include dir: ${PYTHON_INCLUDE}")
    endif()

    # Python ABI 后缀
    string(REGEX REPLACE "python([0-9]+)\\.?([0-9]*)" "\\1\\2" PY_VER_SHORT ${PY_VER})

    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "aarch64")

        ${PYBIND_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/include
        ${PYBIND_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/include/pcl-1.13

    )

    target_link_directories(${MODULE_NAME_VER} PRIVATE ${EMBOSA_SDK_LIB_DIR} ${PYBIND_THIRDPARTY_LIB_DIR})

    target_link_libraries(${MODULE_NAME_VER} PRIVATE ${EMBOSA_SDK_LIBS}

# Galbot SDK 入门教程

这个目录教你打通:**源码 → C++ 编译 → Python 绑定(pybind)→ Python 调用** 全流程。

## 整个 SDK 是什么(一句话版)

```
galbot_g1_sdk_source         ← 源码(全是 C++)
    ├── build.sh             ← 第 1 步:把 C++ 源码编译成 C++ 库
    ├── pybind/build_pybind.sh ← 第 2 步:把 C++ 库再包一层,变成 Python 能 import 的模块
    └── output/...           ← 最终产物(我们不用动它,只引用)
```

过程像做三明治:

```
C++源码 --build.sh--> C++库(.so + .h)  --build_pybind.sh--> Python模块(galbot_sdk)
                                                                    │
                                                    PYTHONPATH 指过去就能 import
```

## 三层的产物各自在哪

| 层 | 产物位置 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| ① C++ 库 | `sdk/galbot_g1_sdk_source/output/galbot_sdk/linux-x86_64-gcc940/` | `include/`(头文件)+ `lib/`(所有 .so) |
| ② Python 模块 | 同上目录下 `lib/python/galbot_sdk/` | `galbot_sdk.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so` + `g1/g3/s1` 子包 |
| ③ 你的代码 | `sdk-tutorial/python/` | 你写的 .py,靠 `PYTHONPATH` 找到 ② |

> `gcc940` = gcc 9.4.0(编译 SDK 用固定工具链,见 `/opt/galbot/toolchain/gcc940-x86_64-ubuntu2004-gnu`)。
> `cpython-310` = 对应 Python 3.10。**你的 Python 版本必须匹配**,否则 import 报错。

## 一次跑通(推荐顺序)

```bash
cd ~/bj-retail-migration/sdk-tutorial

# 第 0 步:体检——检查 Python 版本、工具链、产物齐不齐
bash scripts/00_check_env.sh

# 第 1 步:编译 C++ SDK(产物已有会自动跳过,想强制重编加 --force)
bash scripts/01_build_cpp.sh linux-x86_64-gcc940 release

# 第 2 步:编译 Python 绑定(会针对 3.8~3.14 各编一份,增量很快)
bash scripts/02_build_pybind.sh x86_64

# 第 3 步:跑 Python 示例(自动设置 PYTHONPATH)
bash scripts/03_run_python.sh python/01_hello_sdk.py
```

## 逐步讲解

### 第 0 步:检查环境
`00_check_env.sh` 会挨个检查四件事,哪项红叉就补哪项:
1. `python3` 版本(要 3.8 ~ 3.14,本机是 3.10)
2. x86_64 工具链 g++ 9.4.0 在不在(`/opt/galbot/toolchain/...`)
3. C++ 产物 `libgalbot_sdk.so` 编好了没
4. Python 模块 `galbot_sdk.cpython-XXX.so` 编好了没

### 第 1 步:编译 C++ SDK
实际就是执行官方脚本,`build.sh` 内部:
- 用工具链(gcc 9.4.0)cmake 编译所有模块(motion / robot / navigation / perception)
- 安装到 `output/galbot_sdk/linux-x86_64-gcc940/`

```bash
cd sdk/galbot_g1_sdk_source
./build.sh linux-x86_64-gcc940 release
```

> 构建目录 `.build-linux-x86_64-gcc940/` 里的只是**中间产物**(对象文件),可以随便删,正式产物在 `output/`。

### 第 2 步:编译 Python 绑定(pybind)
pybind11 做的是:把 C++ 类(如 `GalbotRobot`)用 `PYBIND11_MODULE` 暴露给 Python。
`build_pybind.sh` 内部:
- 链接第 1 步的 C++ 库 + 固定 pybind 头文件
- 一次性生成 3.8 ~ 3.14 共 7 个 `.so`(每种 Python ABI 一份)
- 把 `__init__.py`、`g1/` `g3/` `s1/` 包装包一起拷到 `output/.../lib/python/galbot_sdk/`

### 第 3 步:Python 调用

```bash
export PYTHONPATH=$HOME/bj-retail-migration/sdk/galbot_g1_sdk_source/output/galbot_sdk/linux-x86_64-gcc940/lib/python
python3 python/01_hello_sdk.py
```

| 脚本 | 需要机器人吗 | 干什么 |

| `01_hello_sdk.py` | ❌ 不需要 | 验证 import、打印版本和 API 数量 |
| `02_explore_api.py` | ❌ 不需要 | 翻 API:枚举、类、方法清单 |
| `03_connect_robot.py` | ✅ 需要 | 连机器人:初始化 → 读关节状态 → 退出(带超时保护) |

## 常见坑

- `ImportError: galbot_sdk shared library not found` → Python 版本不对,看报错里的 `cpython-XXX` 是不是你的版本
- 编译报找不到工具链 → 检查 `/opt/galbot/toolchain/` 是否存在
- 初始化失败/超时 → 机器人没开机或网络不通(SDK 通过 DDS 局域网连机器人)

    set(config_part "${line}")

# ----------------------------
# find_library_files（新版：基于目录全表 + 正则匹配）
#   find_library_files(<lib_dir> <lib_name> <result_var> <exact_flag>)
#   exact_flag: "TRUE" or "FALSE"
# ----------------------------
function(find_library_files lib_dir lib_name result_var exact_flag)
    set(found_files "")

    # 收集目录下所有 .so* 文件（只 glob 一次）
    file(GLOB ALL_SOS RELATIVE "${lib_dir}" "${lib_dir}/*.so*")

    # 构造要匹配的正则（注意 CMake regex 用双反斜杠转义）
    if("${exact_flag}" STREQUAL "FALSE")
        # 模糊匹配：lib<name>_*.so* 或 lib<name>*.so*
        set(pattern1 "^lib${lib_name}_.+\\.so(\\..*)?$")   # libopencv_core.so, libopencv_xxx.so.4.9.0
        set(pattern2 "^lib${lib_name}.+\\.so(\\..*)?$")    # 兼容少见 libopencv*.so 命名
    else()
        # 精确匹配组合：
        # 1) lib<name>.so 或 lib<name>.so.<ver>
        set(p_lib_simple "^lib${lib_name}\\.so(\\..*)?$")
        # 2) lib<name>-<ver>.so 或 lib<name>-<ver>.so.<ver>  (foonathan_memory-0.7.3)
        set(p_lib_dash "^lib${lib_name}-.+\\.so(\\..*)?$")
        # 3) lib<name><digits>*.so* (例如 libpng16.so, libpng16.so.16.43.0)
        set(p_lib_digits "^lib${lib_name}[0-9].*\\.so(\\..*)?$")
        # 4) 无 lib 前缀的 <name>.so 或 <name>.so.<ver> （例如 protobuf.so.25）
        set(p_nolib "^${lib_name}\\.so(\\..*)?$")
    endif()

    foreach(f ${ALL_SOS})
        # f 是相对路径下的文件名，如 libpng16.so.16.43.0
        if("${exact_flag}" STREQUAL "FALSE")
            if(f MATCHES ${pattern1} OR f MATCHES ${pattern2})
                # push with full path
                list(APPEND found_files "${lib_dir}/${f}")
            endif()
        else()
            if(f MATCHES ${p_lib_simple} OR f MATCHES ${p_lib_dash} OR f MATCHES ${p_lib_digits} OR f MATCHES ${p_nolib})
                list(APPEND found_files "${lib_dir}/${f}")
            endif()
        endif()
    endforeach()

    # 去重与排序（稳定输出）
    if(found_files)
        list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES found_files)
        list(SORT found_files)
    endif()

    set(${result_var} ${found_files} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
